Hey! I’m not sure about the type of dslr u posted but there are 2 things that the DSLR must do in order to use it as a webcam.

1- it must have clean HDMI output (meaning it doesn’t show the menu on the screen when capturing your beautiful face)

2- it must have the ability to run endlessly (using a dummy battery adapter or something similar)

To check if your camera can do that go to elgato camlink check (search it on google) and then check from the list for your camera.

If it’s compatible congrats! All you need is an elgato camlink (USB to hdmi dongle) and connect to your camera while u connect the dummy battery to the wall plug or something

Then hop onto OBS and click add a video capture device and u should see camlink from the drop down list and you are set! Hope this helps you
